chunk_content: Thus, HIV testing conducted to verify one’s HI - positive status should not be counted under HTS_TST, since the initial HIV diagnosis will have already been counted at the point of the initial receipt of the HIV diagnosis. 4. Patient-level deduplication adding “has patient been tested in the last months” to the HTS facility and community registers can help implementing partners de-duplicate at the quarterly reporting level. How to review for data quality: Only one disaggregation type is used for age/sex/test result received: • Numerator ≥ subtotal of each of the disaggregations How to calculate annual total: Sum results across quarters.
